memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis
- Status: Active, morning stiffness 45 min, joint swelling in MCP and PIP joints, pain VAS 5/10.
- Plan: Continue methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD. Check weight and waist.
Weight: 58 kg. Waist: 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, within limit).
Diet advice:
- Breakfast: Include protein (egg or dal) and avoid refined sugars.
- Lunch: Balanced plate with vegetables, whole‑grain roti, lean protein.
- Dinner: Light, avoid fried foods, include salad.
Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

- Status: Flare, increased wrist and knee pain, morning stiffness 30 min, pain VAS 5/10, mild swelling noted.
- Plan: Add short course of prednisolone 10 mg OD for 5 days then taper to 5 mg OD, continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine. Advise joint protection and rest.
Weight: 58 kg. Waist: 78 cm.
Diet advice:

- Lunch: Vegetable khichdi with curd.
- Dinner: Grilled chicken, sautéed greens, minimal oil.
Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
